$comment: ADR-0019: what each workflow's verdict is about. ARIA's failing_ci plan source
(aria-kernel/aria_kernel/plan_synthesizer.py scan_failing_ci) supplies a candidate only for
a red main_verdict workflow; a red pr_verdict or observer workflow is logged once per cycle
as failing_ci_workflow_excluded. A workflow missing from this file counts as main_verdict.
main_verdict: the verdict is about main or production (CI on main, post-deploy e2e,
production probes, ARIA lanes running main's kernel, aria-daily-report).
pr_verdict: the verdict is about one pull request.
observer: the verdict is computed from OTHER workflows' runs; `observes` names them.
`name` is the workflow's `name:` key: GitHub reports a run under it, and the kernel joins
runs to roles on it. tests/invariants/workflow-roles.spec.ts pins every entry to the files

workflows.name: Apollo Router Security
workflows.reason: Dispatched header-stripping pen-test of a live Apollo Router (the deployed edge).

workflows.name: Apollo Supergraph Validate
workflows.reason: Supergraph composition check that runs on push to main.

workflows.name: aria-agent-eval
workflows.reason: Weekly agent-eval fixtures run by main's kernel.

workflows.name: aria-agent-executor
workflows.reason: ARIA drain lane on main's kernel; it reads cycle runs only to chain the next one.

workflows.name: aria-auto-cycle
workflows.reason: Nightly ARIA producer lane on main's kernel.

workflows.name: aria-daily-report
workflows.reason: Daily ARIA report published from main; ADR-0019 names it a main verdict.

workflows.name: ARIA External Watchdog
workflows.reason: Judges the ARIA lanes' last success and the aria/state tip they publish.

workflows.name: aria-kernel
workflows.reason: ARIA kernel suite that runs on push to main.

workflows.name: aria-merge-authority
workflows.reason: Required check on each PR and merge group: judges the PR head's merge evidence.

workflows.name: aria-merge-runner
workflows.reason: Merge lane on main's kernel; `merge-lane run` exits 0 whatever it decides on a PR.

workflows.name: ARIA Operational Proof
workflows.reason: Dispatched proof of ARIA's suite and observe burn-in on main.

workflows.name: aria-readiness-claim
workflows.reason: Assembles one PR head's readiness claim after its aria-merge-authority run.

workflows.name: ARIA runner capability probe
workflows.reason: Probes the self-hosted runner that main's ARIA lanes run on.

workflows.name: ARIA State Maintenance
workflows.reason: Compacts and republishes aria/state with main's kernel.

workflows.name: backup-manifest-invariant
workflows.reason: pull_request-only gate: backup bundle and its hash manifest stay in lockstep.

workflows.name: Backup - Production Postgres
workflows.reason: Production Postgres backup: a red is a production backup failure.

workflows.name: Backup SSH Broker Release
workflows.reason: Builds and signs the backup SSH broker from a push to main.

workflows.name: Build Selected Images

workflows.name: CI - Affected

workflows.name: CI - Edge Agent (sens-api-gateway)

workflows.name: CI - Full

workflows.name: Closes Footer Check

workflows.name: Database WAL Archive Freshness

workflows.name: dataflow-integrity-watchdog

workflows.name: Database Migration Check
